senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="T00462"><he>רזב</he></cite>, transpos. of <cite ref="B01216"><he>ברז</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="B01254"><he>בָּרֵיז</he></cite>)
tube, spout; esp. the movable tube attached to the roof gutters (מַזְחִילָה).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 3:6">B. Bath. III, 6</cite> <he>המ׳ אין לו חזקה</he> no claim, based on undisturbed use, can be made for the special position of the pipe discharging the water into the neighbor’s yard; expl.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 58b">ib. 58ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. III, end, 14ᵇ <he>מקום המ׳ בחצר יש … מקום קילוחו וכ׳</he> the right of a pipe for the discharge of water into the neighbor’s court can be claimed on the basis of undisturbed use, but not the special place of its discharge; (<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 2:13">Tosef. ib. II, 13</cite> <he>צינור</he>).
<cite ref="Yevamot 75b:15">Yeb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>כמ׳</he> if the mutilated membrum has the shape of a spout (leaving the urinary canal unprotected).
<cite ref="Shabbat 146b:8">Sabb. 146ᵇ</cite> <he>גזירה משום מ׳</he> it is forbidden, lest he shape a regular tapping tube (v. <cite ref="B01217"><he>בִּרְזָא</he> I</cite>).

senses.gloss: a sort of cape, having the shape of a gutter, formed by throwing the edges of a garment over the shoulders backward. Ib. 147ᵃ, v. כִּיסָא.
